> This is the **Nix flake** version of the RSM-MSBA environment. Instead of
> Docker Desktop and a multi-gigabyte container image, you install native Nix
> and get the exact same Python, Quarto, PostgreSQL, and Spark toolchain built
> reproducibly on your own machine. There is **no Docker**, no container to
> start, and nothing littered across your system — everything lives in the Nix
> store and one workspace folder (`~/rsm-msba`) that you can delete to fully
> reset.
